Sound familiar?

You know what you want to change. So why doesn’t it stick?

  • You promise yourself this time will be different, then slip back into the old habit.
  • You’ve read the books and done the journaling. The insight is there, the change isn’t.
  • You look after your body carefully. Your mind gets whatever is left.
  • You’re curious about hypnosis, but not sure what it really is.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why willpower runs out

How habits are driven by the subconscious, and why trying harder on the surface rarely changes them.

Where your patterns come from

How early beliefs quietly shape the choices you make every day, and how to start noticing them.

What hypnosis really is (and isn’t)

A plain-English look at hypnosis, RTT and neuroplasticity, without the stage-show myths.

Mental longevity

Why your mind deserves the same daily care as your body, and simple habits to start this week.

A live guided hypnosis

Experience a relaxing guided session with Anna, so you know exactly how it feels.

Script 1 · “This time will be different”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’ve ever said ‘this time will be different’ and it wasn’t, here’s why.”

Body

“Most of what we do every day runs on habit, not decisions. That’s why trying harder on the surface so often fades. The change has to happen where the habit lives, in the subconscious.”

CTA

“I explain how in a free 60-minute class called The Subconscious Reset, with a guided hypnosis at the end. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera on your light grey sofa, white shirt, soft daylight. On-screen: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “Mental longevity”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“We train our bodies for the long run. Almost nobody trains their mind.”

Body

“We plan workouts, sleep and skincare, and leave our minds running on whatever was installed years ago. Mental longevity is about giving your mind the same care, every day.”

CTA

“I’ll show you where to start in my free live class. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: walking-and-talking or seated, champagne on-screen text “mind = body”.

Script 3 · “What hypnosis really is”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Hypnosis isn’t someone taking control of your mind. Here’s what it actually is.”

Body

“It’s a relaxed, focused state, a bit like being absorbed in a good book. You stay aware the whole time, and it lets you look at old patterns with fresh eyes.”

CTA

“Want to feel it for yourself? I’ll guide you through one live in my free class. Tap Sign up.”
